title: H2 database locking causes flaky golden test failures when multiple JVMs start concurrently
description:
When golden tests start the potato (opponent) JVM client concurrently with the replay client, both JVMs initialize their card databases simultaneously. The H2 embedded database in ExpansionRepository sometimes fails with a locking error:

  Cannot invoke "com.j256.ormlite.dao.Dao.queryBuilder()" because "this.expansionDao" is null

This happens because the H2 database connection fails during concurrent initialization (SessionRemote -> JdbcConnection). The root cause is that multiple JVM processes try to access the same H2 database file simultaneously, and H2's file-level locking rejects the second connection.

The failure is intermittent — it depends on timing. Retrying the test usually passes. Observed in test_initial_decision but could affect any golden test.

Possible fixes:
- Use separate database directories per JVM (e.g. via a system property)
- Serialize JVM startup in golden_helpers.py so the potato client starts after the replay client has finished DB init
- Use H2 in server mode instead of embedded mode
